data.short_description: After two years operating from a food truck, Bake n’ Soda is preparing a permanent brick‑and‑mortar at 901 S. Main St. in downtown Springfield. Owner Kodie Cash is overseeing the build‑out and aims to open in October 2026, offering its signature dirty sodas, floats, desserts and an expanded menu.

Diversified Restaurant Group plans to convert an existing restaurant property at 3828 Hamner Ave. in Eastvale into a new Taco Bell. The tenant‑improvement project includes a drive‑thru lane, but construction start dates are still to be determined.

data.location: 3500 East Parmer Lane, Suite 10150, Austin, TX 78754, USA
data.short_description: Torchy’s Tacos announced a new location in Austin’s East Village at 3500 East Parmer Lane, Suite 10150. Public filings show the restaurant is slated to open in spring 2027, adding to the chain’s Texas expansion.

data.status: construction is slated to wrap by June 2027
data.short_description: Dave’s Hot Chicken is targeting a standalone site at 2801 E Central Expressway in Melissa for a Killeen‑area restaurant. Permitting records indicate construction should be completed by June 2027, though the franchisee has not confirmed an opening date.

Richie’s Real American Diner is moving forward with a new Menifee eatery at 29787 Antelope Road, Suite 110. Construction documents list an 8,820‑sq‑ft dine‑in restaurant, but no opening date has been announced.

The Kent Memphis transformed a historic 1883 building in Memphis’ Snuff District into a 27,000‑square‑foot event venue. It opened in February 2022 and hosts weddings, galas, and other large gatherings.
Over Keel at The Kent is a neighboring wine bar with counter service, offering 75‑80 seats, small bites, and a wine list. It opened in June next to The Kent Memphis.
Lira Italian Kitchen will relocate to the former Chase Bank building at 4056 E. Main St. in Hilliard. The project is part of a mixed‑use development and is slated to open in 2028.

data.location: 220 W Frontier Pkwy #100, Prosper, TX 75078, USA
data.short_description: Mountain Mike’s Pizza filed public plans to open a new restaurant at 220 W. Frontier Parkway, Suite 100 in Prosper, Texas. The chain is expanding rapidly across Collin County.

data.status: opening a second location in early fall 2026
data.short_description: Lowe’s Donuts announced a second bakery near The Cormorant restaurant in Newburyport, scheduled for early fall 2026. The new shop will offer seating, unlike the original grab‑and‑go Haverhill location.

Honeycomb bakery and café plans to open a second North Shore location at the former Barrelman space on Washington Street in Marblehead. The owners aim for a February 2027 opening, pending design and permits.

Que Onda Tacos is planning its sixth and flagship restaurant in Charlotte’s Montford area at 1515 Mockingbird Lane. The 64‑seat indoor space will include a 44‑seat bar and a 70‑seat outdoor patio, with an anticipated debut early next year.

Pure Green is set to open its first Bay Area juice‑bar in Fremont’s Centerville district at 37140 Fremont Blvd. The 1,051‑sq‑ft shop will create 10‑12 jobs and will feature cold‑pressed juices, smoothies, bowls and sourdough toast.

Public filings show Whataburger intends to open a new restaurant at 2733 TX‑36 Business in Gatesville. Permitting records list a start date of June 8 2026 and a completion date of January 4 2027. The chain has not responded to inquiries about the timeline.

Casa Mia filed a California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control license for a new location at 677 Laurel St., Suite B, in San Carlos. The restaurant will bring its breakfast‑focused casual dining concept to the Peninsula, though no opening date has been announced.

Tamra & Co. is preparing a Saudi‑inspired café and gift shop in Seattle’s Pike Place Market, slated for a fall opening. Founder Razan Kattoa says the current target is November, though permitting could shift the timeline. The 650‑sq‑ft space will sell date‑based sweets, pastries, coffee and packaged gifts.

data.location: 32545 Golden Lantern, Suite C, Dana Point, CA 92629
data.short_description: Urbane Cafe is set to open a new location in Dana Point at 32545 Golden Lantern, Suite C. The plan review was filed with the Orange County Health Care Agency, but no opening date has been announced. The restaurant will serve made‑to‑order sandwiches and salads.

data.location: 1621 S Dixie Hwy Unit 117, Pompano Beach, FL 33060
data.short_description: Cuban Cafe Pompano is a proposed new restaurant at 1621 S Dixie Highway, Unit 117, occupying the former Surreala Coffee space. An application has been received, but no opening date is provided. The concept will likely offer coffees, teas, and sandwiches.

data.status: currently moving through the permitting and build-out processes
data.short_description: 8D Rodeo Bar & Thrill is planning a new venue at the Wolfchase Galleria, located at 2760 N Germantown Parkway in Memphis. The owners are in permitting and build‑out stages, and an opening date has not been set. The venue will combine dining with a mechanical bull and an 8D motion cinema.

Cafe Zupas is renovating the former Applebee’s building at 1161 Polaris Parkway in Columbus to create its fourth Central Ohio restaurant, adding a drive‑thru. The project is a remodel, and no specific opening date is given. The space previously housed Applebee’s, which closed this summer.

data.location: 12465 Northlake Blvd #100, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33412
data.short_description: Tenka Sushi – Modern Asian is preparing to open at 12465 Northlake Blvd, Suite 100 in Palm Beach Gardens. The owners target an October or November opening, and the 4,000‑sq‑ft space will feature an open kitchen, sushi bar, full bar, and patio. The filing shows the restaurant moving through the state approval process.
Maman, a popular bakery, is moving into the former Black Coffee storefront at 4885 MacArthur Blvd NW in Washington, DC. Work is underway and the company is recruiting staff for the new location.

data.location: 222 E Bland St, Charlotte, NC 28203, USA
data.status: aiming to secure its conditional occupancy permit within two weeks
data.short_description: Lady Funari, a new pasta bar and café, is being built at the former Futo Buta space at 222 E Bland St in Charlotte’s South End. The owners hope to obtain a conditional occupancy permit soon and target an October opening.

data.location: 233 W Santa Clara St, San Jose, CA 95113
data.short_description: Tejer, a Mexican restaurant by Cal‑India Collective, plans to open in the historic Hotel De Anza at 233 W Santa Clara St, San Jose, with a 95‑seat dining room slated for this winter.
Blue Corn Cafe & Bakery intends to add an Avondale location in Orange County, with the new site expected to open in fall 2026, though no street address or exact date has been released.
embe Cafe, a new premium coffee and food concept, will open at 1600 Alton Rd in Miami Beach, with the website listing the South Beach spot as “coming soon” and no opening date announced.

The Bungalow, a Southern California bar and lounge concept, is preparing to open a new location in San Diego within IQHQ’s RaDD waterfront development. No exact address, size, or opening date has been announced. The proposal follows a previously cancelled Westfield UTC project.

data.status: expected to open in late September 2026
data.short_description: Tori Japan plans to open a restaurant at the former Boston Halal space at 961 Commonwealth Avenue near Boston University. The approximately 3,000‑square‑foot venue is expected to open in late September 2026. This will be the first of four new Greater Boston locations.

data.location: 11 Boulevard René-Lévesque O, Québec, QC G1R 2V5, Canada
data.short_description: Chef Étienne Nadeau is opening a new restaurant called Mano at 11 Boulevard René‑Lévesque O in Québec. The venue is slated to open in September, with a menu focused on fresh pasta. Details on design and menu remain limited.

Pressed Café is expanding to Boston’s Fenway neighborhood with a new location at 126 Brookline Avenue. The chain describes the site as “coming soon” and anticipates opening in the winter of 2026 after earlier plans for a late‑fall debut. The expansion adds to its 12 existing Massachusetts locations.

data.store_name: Tulum Grill (Tulum Mexican and American Cuisine)
data.location: 1580 NW 2nd Ave, Suite 10, Boca Raton, FL 33432
data.short_description: A new Tulum Grill concept, branded Tulum Mexican and American Cuisine, is planned for 1580 NW 2nd Avenue, Suite 10 in Boca Raton. The project is listed in a recent site‑plan application, but no opening date has been announced. The concept will offer Mexican‑American dishes and is part of Food Madness’s expansion.

Layne’s Chicken Fingers, a Texas‑based fried chicken chain, is planning its first California locations across Sacramento, Placer, Fresno and Monterey counties. Franchisee Tariq Munir has signed an agreement for 12 sites, with the first expected in early or mid‑2027. No specific address or opening date has been disclosed.

data.store_name: Mark Rich’s New York Pizza & Pasta
data.location: 1930 Rock Springs Dr, Las Vegas, NV 89128
data.short_description: Mark Rich’s New York Pizza & Pasta is set to return to the Las Vegas Valley, planning to reopen in Pioneer Park within the Rock Springs Plaza at 1930 Rock Springs Dr. The permit indicates an expected opening sometime this year or early next year, but no exact date is given.

data.location: 180 St Paul St, St. Catharines, ON L2R 3M2, Canada
data.short_description: Sunset Steak & Cheese is a new restaurant planned by Zach Smith, owner of Fat Rabbit, to open at 180 St. Paul St in St. Catharines. The venue is slated to open in November and will feature Philadelphia‑style sandwiches, hot dogs, and chili‑cheese fries.

data.location: 15 Queens Quay E, Toronto, ON M5E 0C5, Canada
data.status: is closing at the end of the month
data.short_description: NBA Courtside, the sports bar at 15 Queens Quay East, is closing at the end of the month as Urban Dining Group prepares to renovate the space for new concepts.

data.location: 15 Queens Quay E, Toronto, ON M5E 0C5, Canada
data.short_description: Daisy’s Cookies will open as a boutique cookie shop in the former NBA Courtside space at 15 Queens Quay East, with an expected opening in September.

Nicoletto’s Pasta Co. is expanding to Mt. Juliet with a third restaurant at 11324 Lebanon Rd. The 3,000‑sq‑ft location is under construction and aims for a fall 2026 opening, but no specific date has been announced.

data.location: 293 Palmerston Ave, Toronto, ON M6J 2J3, Canada
data.status: slated to open in late September
data.short_description: Casa Rubia will take over Martine’s Wine Bar at 293 Palmerston Ave in Toronto. The Spanish restaurant, created by the team behind Bar Raval, is slated to open in late September 2026 with 50 indoor seats, a mezzanine, and a patio.

data.status: looking to launch in mid-to-late September
data.short_description: Asian Hibachi Grill plans to open on Johns Island at 3575 Maybank Hwy. The Japanese take‑out concept is expected to launch in mid‑to‑late September 2026, featuring hibachi, sushi and some Chinese dishes.

Einstein Bros Bagels is set to open a new spot in the San Jacinto Marketplace, Baytown, at 6609 Garth Rd, Suite 200. Construction is underway and the store should open by this winter 2026, according to a state permit.

data.location: 1780 Markham Rd, Scarborough, ON M1B 2W2, Canada
data.short_description: Punjabi Haveli is opening a fourth location at 1780 Markham Rd in Scarborough. The restaurant is in the final stages of construction, with no opening date disclosed.

The Union Sky is a new rooftop restaurant and cocktail lounge that will occupy the seventh‑floor of Novi Lofts in downtown Concord. The concept will cover 3,085 sq ft indoors and a rooftop patio of over 1,000 sq ft. A specific opening date has not yet been announced.

data.status: tentatively planning on a November 1 launch
data.short_description: King Corona 1902 will be a new cigar bar and members‑only lounge in Ybor City, featuring a two‑story space with a public downstairs bar, coffee bar, lockers, and a members‑only lounge upstairs. The proprietors say the launch is tentatively set for November 1 and membership applications are being accepted.

After temporarily closing its historic Palm Avenue location, Caragiulo’s Italian American is preparing to reopen in a new home at the Mira Mar building on Ringling Blvd. A representative confirmed the restaurant is roughly 30 days from reopening, with hiring already underway.

data.location: 506 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 2B3, Canada
data.short_description: Renso Pho-Potle will bring a customizable pho fast‑casual concept to Toronto, opening its first location at 506 Queen St. West. The restaurant is slated to soft‑open on Sept. 19, with a grand opening planned for Oct. 3.

data.location: 7026 A C Skinner Pkwy, Jacksonville, FL 32256
data.status: still under consideration at the city level
data.short_description: The Predator Group, a billiards supply company, is working to open its first full‑service restaurant and entertainment venue at 7026 AC Skinner Parkway. The project is still under city‑level review and no opening date has been announced.

data.status: official opening date not yet announced
data.short_description: Jamaica House Restaurant is planning a new location at 5971 SW 23rd Street in West Park, FL. The menu will feature Jamaican cuisine and catering services. An official opening date has not yet been announced.

data.status: awaiting more details on the planned rollout of the new Texas Roadhouse location
data.short_description: Texas Roadhouse will be part of the Venice Crossing mixed‑use development in Nokomis, FL. The first stores at the site are expected to open by spring 2027, and the restaurant will be the first Texas Roadhouse in Sarasota County. No specific opening date has been released.

Caribou Coffee plans a new location at 6375 Hickory Flat Highway in Canton, GA, as part of the Hickory Flat Marketplace. The shopping center is expected to open in fall 2026, and the coffee shop will open at that time.

Twin Peaks announced plans to develop restaurants in Brownsville, South Padre Island, and Laredo, Texas, under a new agreement with InnJoy Hospitality. Specific locations and opening dates have not been announced.

data.location: 6365 E Hampden Ave., Suite 101, Denver, CO 80222
data.short_description: Sherry Crossland is adding a fourth Miya Moon restaurant at 6365 E. Hampden Ave., Suite 101 in Denver, slated to open in September. The concept focuses on dim sum and Asian‑inspired small plates.

data.location: 14302 E. Cedar Ave., Unit B, Aurora, CO (zip not provided)
data.status: opening expected in November or December
data.short_description: A new Chubby Fish Sushi location is planned at 14302 E. Cedar Ave., Unit B in Aurora, with an opening expected in November or December.
A second Chubby Fish Sushi restaurant is planned for Arvada, though the address has not been announced. It is expected to open in February 2027.

Soleta Golf Club is planning its food and beverage program. The Nest, the club’s first permanent building, is slated to open this fall as a bar and grill. The club currently operates an interim dining facility while permanent amenities are built.

La Tia y El Paisano is set to open at 5803 15th St E, Suite 10-15 in Bradenton. The new restaurant may combine concepts from the former El Paisano and La Tia Restaurante Guatemala. No further details have been released.

data.status: No opening date has been announced
data.short_description: Mister O1 Extraordinary Pizza announced a new location at 4437 Lyons Road in Coconut Creek. The brand is expanding its South Florida footprint, but no opening date has been provided. The restaurant is known for star‑shaped pizzas.

data.location: 6500 NW 12th Ave, Suite 101, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33309
data.status: No opening date has been announced
data.short_description: Habit Burger & Grill filed permit applications for a new restaurant at 6500 NW 12th Ave, Suite 101 in Fort Lauderdale. The fast‑casual chain is expanding in South Florida, though an opening date remains unannounced. The location will join 14 existing Habit restaurants in Florida.

data.status: expected to open in early fall
data.short_description: Former Food Network contestant Angela Malpedo will open Frosted Chaos at 518 Long St. in Bethlehem, occupying the former Granola Factory space. The bakery will offer cupcakes, cookies, brownies and coffee, with an expected early‑fall opening. No specific date has been set.
Pilar Coffee Bar & Iced Treats is expanding in South Florida with a new Miami location at 17405 S. Dixie Highway. Permit applications have been filed, but an opening date has not been announced.
New York Butcher Shoppe will add a Smyrna location at 4600 West Village Place, Suite 3001. Franchise owners say construction is expected to begin soon, joining six existing Georgia sites.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Damaskino Mediterranean Grill is adding a second Jacksonville location at 3825 Baymeadows Road. A city commercial building permit calls for a tenant build‑out, but no opening date is provided.

data.status: estimated to open its doors by the fall of 2026
data.short_description: Dalmoros Fresh Italian plans its first Jacksonville restaurant at 1018 Park Street in the Five Points neighborhood. The owners estimate the doors will open by the fall of 2026, featuring fresh‑made pasta and a visible pasta machine.

data.location: 1004 W Rosamond Pkwy, Anna, TX 75409, USA
data.short_description: Bahama Buck's is set to open its first Anna‑Melissa area location at 1004 W. Rosamond Parkway, Suite 600. Franchisees confirmed the opening is targeted for spring 2027, with both soft and grand openings planned.

data.status: expected to be completed within the coming months
data.short_description: Crumbl Cookies is planning a new storefront at Cobblestone Village in St. Augustine, taking over the former Hues Hair Salon space. The build‑out has been approved and is expected to be completed in the coming months, but no opening date is announced.

data.status: targeting an opening no later than January 2028
data.short_description: Army Ant’s Cheeseburgers is planning an old‑school burger joint in Avondale, with owners searching for a location. They aim to open no later than January 2028 and have a grand opening celebration planned.

Suki Desu will expand to a Hell’s Kitchen location at 709 9th Ave., occupying the former Manhattan Eyeworks space. The intimate sushi restaurant’s interior will have nine tables and a sushi counter, and its Instagram notes the venue is “Coming soon.”

Little Rosa’s Pizza will become a tenant of the upcoming Hickory Flat Marketplace in Canton, GA, a 100,000‑sq ft shopping center slated to open in fall 2026. The pizza shop will serve New York‑style pizza as part of the new development.
Leon’s Family Dining in Taylor, Michigan, announced it will close permanently after 30 years of service. The restaurant will hold its final dinner and shut its doors on September 13, 2026.
Tootles and French, a bistro and wine bar in Astoria, announced its closure after three years, citing personal reasons. The restaurant’s closure notice was posted in August 2026.
Le Petit Parisien’s Upper East Side location closed in August 2026 after opening in 2022. The closure notice was posted in the window, thanking the community.
Bird & Bao, a casual Asian‑fusion restaurant in Patchogue, announced it is closing its doors after seven years. No specific closure date was provided beyond the August 2026 announcement.

data.status: has not yet announced an opening date
data.short_description: Taco Street is expanding to a new Seattle location at 5602 First Avenue South. A liquor‑license application shows the space will house a restaurant lounge, service bar, and catering area, but no opening date has been given.

data.location: 433 Clay St, San Francisco, CA 94111, United States
data.short_description: Prelude, an upscale Southern‑inspired restaurant inside The Jay Hotel, will permanently shut down on September 19, 2026 due to slow business. Omakase Restaurant Group plans to reopen the space with a new concept later that fall.

Kyuramen Express, a fast‑casual ramen concept, is slated to open in late summer 2026 at 40 Gold Street in Manhattan’s Financial District. The location will share a multi‑brand dining space with Aokō Matcha and Bao Dumplings.

Chick‑fil‑A opened its fifth Brooklyn location on August 27, 2026 at 1569 Flatbush Avenue, creating 80‑90 jobs. The standalone restaurant offers dine‑in, carry‑out, and delivery services and supports local hunger‑relief programs.

Retro Alley Arcade is set to open at 8036 Falls Avenue Southeast in downtown Snoqualmie. The arcade will include a snack bar license, indicating food and beverage offerings. No opening date or menu details have been released.

A new liquor license application shows Mountain Song intends to reopen at 60147 State Route 20, Building A in Marblemount. The restaurant previously closed for the season in September 2023. An opening date has not been provided.

Beef Box German Shawarma will open a second location at 4929 N. Lankershim Boulevard in North Hollywood, the former home of Dog Haus. The fast‑casual concept offers German‑style shawarma with dine‑in, pickup, and delivery. No exact opening date has been announced.

The Woodmont Grill closed its doors in Bethesda after 33 years of operation. The space was purchased by Steve Salis and Catalogue restaurant group. Plans are underway to replace it with a Ted’s Bulletin location.

Catalogue restaurant group plans to open a Ted’s Bulletin outpost in the former Woodmont Grill space at 7715 Woodmont Avenue. The project is in early design stages and targets a 2027 opening. The concept is known for all‑day breakfast and made‑from‑scratch favorites.

Char BBQ, a former pop‑up, is preparing to open a new restaurant in Creekside Plaza, Poway, in the former Tikka Lounge space. Documents show the location at 13513 Poway Rd and the opening is expected within two to three months, though no exact date is given.

data.location: 10250 Santa Monica Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90067
data.short_description: Pura Vida Miami, a wellness‑focused brand, will open its sixth California location at Westfield Century City, 10250 Santa Monica Blvd, Los Angeles. The mall directory lists the concept as a “coming soon” tenant, but no opening date has been announced.

Bossa, a Brazilian café and cocktail bar, will take over the former Choice of India space at 305 NW 21st Ave in Portland. Owners aim for a mid‑October opening after zoning delays pushed back an originally planned spring launch.

The Blue Corn Cafe & Bakery announced plans to open a fourth location in Avondale, targeting a mid‑October opening. The exact address has not been released, and the bakery will share it on social media in the coming weeks.
